name: Economic Aspects of Water Resources Development
description: Economics of water and development, basic economic concepts, financial analysis of a water project, pricing concepts for surface and groundwater, benefit-cost sensitivity analysis for water project, capital budgeting and cost allocation for water project, economic decision trees and risk, water economic policy analysis: price-rationing, quantity rationing, demand shifting, supply shifting, economics of natural resources management, hydro economic model, hydro economic risk assessment, natural resources allowances and depletion, economics of river restoration, economics of trans-boundary water resources management.
